title: Effective computation of generalized abelian complexity for Pisot type substitutive sequences
notes: arXiv:2504.13584. Restates the conjecture that the k-abelian complexity of an ℓ-automatic sequence is ℓ-regular, and records that the general statement remains unresolved. Gives two Walnut constructions: uniformly factor-balanced automatic sequences (synchronized k-abelian predicate, path-counting) and ultimately Pisot substitutions (reduction to abelian complexity of a k-block coding). Current literature status for the kabelian_complexity gate as of 2026.
